events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, starting on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. What's your ultimate festival anthem?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the King of Rock and Roll. Remembering the legendary Elvis Presley.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's 75th
angles.copy: The legendary Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: LG's Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today. What's your favourite Oasis or solo tune from the man himself?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which 007 film or actor is your all-time favourite? Licence to thrill us with your choices!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of The Beatles' John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: The legendary John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: A very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true legend.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury.
